answer_1.quote: Generating personalized headlines is a challenging task due to the constraints of conciseness and the need to capture the reader's attention.

answer_2.quote: We use various metrics to evaluate the entire personalized headline generation pipeline: (1) Relevance Metrics. We use pre-trained DPR and Sentence-BERT models to calculate the relevance score... (2) Recommendation Score... (3) Factual Consistency. We apply the pre-trained FactCC model... (4) Surface Overlap. We use ROUGE-L F1 and Extractive Coverage...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a two-step human evaluation using 16 evaluators who have high English proficiency.
answer_4.guideline: The grading scale ranges from 1 (worst) to 3 (best), and detailed grading standards are provided in Appendix A.3.
